hypotheses.title: Contract locks Ether without a withdraw function
hypotheses.description: It appears that the contract includes a payable function to accept Ether but lacks a corresponding function to withdraw it, which leads to the Ether being locked in the contract. To resolve this issue, please implement a public or external function that allows for the withdrawal of Ether from the contract. Instances: src/LiquidProxy.sol:17

hypotheses.title: ETH transferred without address checks
hypotheses.description: Consider introducing checks for `msg.sender` to ensure the recipient of the money is as intended. Instances: src/LiquidRon.sol:362

hypotheses.title: Reentrancy: State change after external call
hypotheses.description: Changing state after an external call can lead to re-entrancy attacks.Use the checks-effects-interactions pattern to avoid this issue. Instances: src/LiquidRon.sol:136, src/LiquidRon.sol:151

hypotheses.title: Centralization Risk
hypotheses.description: Contracts have owners with privileged rights to perform admin tasks and need to be trusted to not perform malicious updates or drain funds. Instances: src/LiquidRon.sol:97, src/LiquidRon.sol:104, src/LiquidRon.sol:110

hypotheses.title: Costly operations inside loop
hypotheses.description: Invoking `SSTORE` operations in loops may waste gas. Use a local variable to hold the loop computation result. Instances: src/LiquidRon.sol:172, src/LiquidRon.sol:194, src/LiquidRon.sol:219

hypotheses.title: Large Numeric Literal
hypotheses.description: Large literal values multiples of 10000 can be replaced with scientific notation.Use `e` notation, for example: `1e18`, instead of its full numeric value. Instances: src/LiquidRon.sol:50

hypotheses.title: Local Variable Shadows State Variable
hypotheses.description: Rename the local variable that shadows another state variable. Instances: src/LiquidRon.sol:79, src/LiquidRon.sol:80, src/LiquidRon.sol:306

hypotheses.title: Missing Inheritance
hypotheses.description: There is an interface / abstract contract that is potentially missing (not included in) the inheritance of this contract. Instances: src/Escrow.sol:18

hypotheses.title: Loop Contains `require`/`revert`
hypotheses.description: Avoid `require` / `revert` statements in a loop because a single bad item can cause the whole transaction to fail. It's better to forgive on fail and return failed elements post processing of the loop Instances: src/LiquidRon.sol:172, src/LiquidRon.sol:194

hypotheses.title: State Change Without Event
hypotheses.description: There are state variable changes in this function but no event is emitted. Consider emitting an event to enable offchain indexers to track the changes. Instances: src/LiquidRon.sol:97, src/LiquidRon.sol:104, src/LiquidRon.sol:110

hypotheses.title: Address State Variable Set Without Checks
hypotheses.description: Check for `address(0)` when assigning values to address state variables. Instances: src/LiquidProxy.sol:24, src/LiquidProxy.sol:25, src/LiquidRon.sol:82

hypotheses.title: State Variable Could Be Immutable
hypotheses.description: State variables that are only changed in the constructor should be declared immutable to save gas. Add the `immutable` attribute to state variables that are only changed in the constructor Instances: src/Escrow.sol:21, src/LiquidProxy.sol:20, src/LiquidProxy.sol:21

hypotheses.title: Unchecked Return
hypotheses.description: Function returns a value but it is ignored. Consider checking the return value. Instances: src/Escrow.sol:25, src/LiquidRon.sol:86, src/LiquidRon.sol:372

hypotheses.title: Unsafe ERC20 Operation
hypotheses.description: ERC20 functions may not behave as expected. For example: return values are not always meaningful. It is recommended to use OpenZeppelin's SafeERC20 library. Instances: src/Escrow.sol:25, src/LiquidRon.sol:86, src/LiquidRon.sol:372

hypotheses.title: Unspecific Solidity Pragma
hypotheses.description: Consider using a specific version of Solidity in your contracts instead of a wide version. For example, instead of `pragma solidity ^0.8.0;`, use `pragma solidity 0.8.0;` Instances: src/Escrow.sol:2, src/LiquidProxy.sol:2, src/LiquidRon.sol:2

hypotheses.title: Public Function Not Used Internally
